title: Corollary 7.5.11: a component of the regular set, with multiplicity one, is a minimizing cycle
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} be open, N ∈ 𝒪 (oriented embedded C² (n+1)-submanifold, (N̄∖N) ∩ U = ∅, N ∩ U ≠ ∅) with orientation ξ_N, E ⊆ N ∩ U measurable, T = ∂[[E]] in U, T minimizing in N ∩ U. Let T = τ(M, θ, ξ) be any integer multiplicity representation, y ∈ reg T, M₁ the connected component of reg T containing y, and T₁ ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with T₁(ω) = ∫_{M₁} ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dH^n. Then ∂T₁ = 0 in U and T₁ is minimizing in U ∩ N.
